messages:
vivian (sec): Quick flag 1: our scheduled KMS key rotate for signer-prod completed overnight and the multi-arch image index signing failed for the arm64 manifest. Saw validation errors from the verifier.

lee (infra): saw that too, alert routed to infra. Logs: `cosign verify: manifest digest mismatch for platform arm64` and `manifest list: platform not found` in some registries.

jun (runtime): is this the new KMS policy change we applied? I removed broad kms.keys.get and left only `asymmetricSign` for the signer SA. Could that break cosign plugin during remote signing?

vivian (sec): possible. Before we panic: we need a scoped plan: (1) triage if signature generation failed or if ingestion/verification side failed to fetch attestation, (2) avoid mass rebuilds if only indexes need re-signing, (3) ensure audit export for all signing events.

lee (infra): I can repro in staging. Running a test sign of the amd64 image works, arm64 fails with `failed to build manifest list: tag mismatch`. Working theory: our k8s job that uploads the combined manifest used an older `manifest-tool` image that flattens platform order; cosign plugin expects canonical ordering which changed after the key rotation due to different timestamp ordering.

paul (oncall): ops checklist: create a scoped IAM role `roles/cloudkms.signerLimited` with only `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.asymmetricSign` and bind to `image-signer-prod`. No storage or registry perms. Also enable audit sink to `sinks/image-signer-audit` exporting to `gs://redwood-audits/signer-2026/` with object ACL locked.

vivian (sec): +1 on scoped role. Also: add immutable copy to S3: s3://redwood-image-audit/signer-2026/ with server-side encryption and retention 2y. We must capture the original signatures before any re-sign.

jun (runtime): for the verifier, we can relax platform index strictness for 24h and accept manifest lists where `mediaType` matches `application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.list.v2+json` even if ordering differs. I'll add a feature flag `verifier.accept_reordered_index=true` behind canary.

lee (infra): infra will publish a hotfix runner image with `manifest-tool:v1.0.8` pinned. Building now. Also creating `image-signer-prod` job which will: pull platform-specific images, sign each platform blob individually, then create canonical index and upload with cosign attach.

build-bot: created PR: github.com/redwood-infra/image-signer/pull/47 by lee - pins manifest-tool and adds cosign preflight step.

paul (oncall): rollback playbook if verifier breaks: 
```
# revert verifier flag
kubectl annotate deployment/verifier revert-accept-reorder=true -n security
kubectl set env deployment/verifier verifier.features=default -n security
# remove temporary IAM binding
gcloud iam service-accounts remove-iam-policy-binding image-signer-prod@redwood --member="serviceAccount:image-signer-prod@redwood" --role=roles/cloudkms.signerLimited
```

vivian (sec): also run trivy and our internal SBOM diff on the reindexed images to ensure no layer ordering changed hashes unexpectedly. If any layer digest differs from pre-rotate backups, halt and escalate.

jun (runtime): I'll add `reindex.audit_id` to the verifier telemetry and emit a signed event for each manifest attach. That event must hit auditpipe and be stored.

lee (infra): staging job run finished: cosign preflight shows `cosign version 2.0.3` and KMS sign attempt succeeded with `asymmetricSign`. The manifest-tool step failed earlier; after pin it passed. Posting logs in PR.

vivian (sec): good. Approve PR after adding the audit export step and a small note in the incident ticket. I'll send a security-cc email about the temporary verifier relax window (24h) and the IAM binding.

paul (oncall): scheduled maint window: 2026-04-09T03:30:00Z for 60m. Will run signer job on canary repos first then prod. Created INC-4732 and linked PR-47.

jun (runtime): final note: ensure build artifacts (manifest lists + individual platform manifests) are backed up to s3://redwood-image-backups/multiarch-pre-rotate/ before any re-sign. I'll add a pre-check in the job.

vivian (sec): thanks. Keep updates here, tag me for any failed samples. :lock:
